NINE UNKNOWNS, all one cause: Figma exports auto line-height as `leading-
[normal]` and the code sets explicit leading (20 on the tabs, 24 on the title,
16/18 on the labels). `normal` against a pixel value is not comparable, so
diff reports UNKNOWN rather than inventing an answer. Deleting the explicit
leading to make the comparison possible would be conforming to the
INSTRUMENT, not the board.
